title: Notice Five Things
intro: A small game of noticing. There are no right answers, just look and listen around you.

steps.text: Quietly name five things you can see from where you sit.
Listen for four sounds, near or far. Even the quiet hum counts.
Notice three things you can feel, such as your chair, your clothes, or the air.
Find two colours near you that you like.
Take one slow breath, in and out.

closing: Five rounds of noticing done. Carry on whenever you are ready.
